sources.transformations: Existing yfinance nine-pair daily raw -> spike-cleaned -> FRED carry-augmented caches, used byte-for-byte without new repair or carry estimation. Issue #22 audited raw/clean/carry hashes and all value differences (docs/research/results/issue22/data_lineage.json). Repair recipe: residual_threshold=0.08, reversal_tolerance=0.04, expected_repairs=14 (33 OHLC cells). Documented carry lag=60 calendar days; original FRED response/vintage and creation arguments were not embedded. Current data_quality.py/carry.py/features.py hashes are captured in runtime.source_sha256; those hashes do not prove the original transformation code revision. Future-neighbor cleaning and revised rates remain historical-research assumptions.
sources.rate_vintage: Historical FRED vintage and publication timestamps are unknown. The already-sealed CarryAnnual values are used as historical-research inputs; no current vintage is substituted or downloaded.
sources.available_at_evidence: Unknown for the historical cache; calendar available_at is null, never synthesized from session_close or current retrieval time.
